sources.title: JADES GOODS-S subregion modeled PSFs
sources.access: Direct FITS links in team directory
sources.science_use: Independent PSF generator for injection morphology and held-out filters
sources.caveats: Model PSFs are not independent real point-source truth. Match channel, pixel scale, normalization and drizzle to science image.

sources.title: JADES GOODS-S photometry
sources.access: Direct FITS; use bounded table extraction after deliberate large acquisition
sources.caveats: 6.17 GB full file; not fetched by default. Photometric redshifts are not independent spectroscopic labels.
sources.terms: Not stated on inspected release page; cite the source and verify redistribution terms.

sources.title: JADES released redshifts, fluxes and spectra
sources.science_use: Spectroscopically confirmed reference set including low-z interlopers
sources.caveats: Targeted and heterogeneous spectroscopy; no unbiased survey completeness. Slit loss assumes point morphology; flag redshift quality and extraction.
sources.terms: Not stated on inspected release page; cite the source and verify redistribution terms.

sources.title: JWSTSTARS real stellar photometry and drizzled references
sources.version: DR1 V1 (2024); page includes DR2 WLM RR Lyrae V1 (2026)
sources.science_use: Real external stars for morphology/photometry validation. Program 1334 M92 has F090W,F150W,F277W,F444W.
sources.caveats: Crowding, saturation, temporal/field PSF shifts; exclude M92 exposure 3 (astrometric jitter). HLSP reference image F150W only; other-filter exposures via MAST.
sources.terms: CC BY 4.0 stated on MAST HLSP page; cite 10.17909/cn6n-xg90 and appropriate release papers.

sources.title: DAWN COSMOS reduced imaging used for MoM-z14
sources.access: S3 public products and documented FITS cutout API
sources.science_use: Reproduce imaging selection with science + variance/weight images
sources.caveats: Use exact footprints; zero/absent coverage is not nondetection. Header units and resampled correlated noise must be checked. Whole mosaics are large.
sources.terms: Not stated on inspected release page; cite the source and verify redistribution terms.

sources.science_use: Independent spectral reductions and identification of program 5224 targets
sources.caveats: Program 5224 listing alone does not verify MoM-z14 target spectrum availability. Match RA/Dec/source ID before downloading.

sources.title: MoM-z14 discovery and preliminary UV abundances
sources.access: Open paper; tables transcribed separately with provenance
sources.science_use: Pin line fluxes and model-dependent abundance uncertainties for hypothesis tests
sources.caveats: Individual lines only SNR 2.7–3.4; [N/C]=0.90 +0.29/-0.63 dex in v2. Published line table is not pixel spectrum or posterior samples.
sources.terms: Not stated on inspected release page; cite the source and verify redistribution terms.

sources.title: Rapid Chemical Enrichment by Intermittent Star Formation in GN-z11
sources.science_use: Alternative WR starburst mechanism and element predictions
sources.caveats: GN-z11 mechanism not automatically applicable to MoM-z14; ~100 Myr quiescence and brief (<1 Myr) enhancement are model assumptions.
sources.terms: Not stated on inspected release page; cite the source and verify redistribution terms.

sources.title: Very massive stars and Nitrogen emitting galaxies
sources.science_use: Compare very massive stars with WR and supermassive-star yields
sources.caveats: Model mass loss strongly affects predictions; proposals do not establish the stellar population of MoM-z14.

sources.science_use: Cosmological chemical evolution comparison for supermassive-star pollution
